title: fix: examples defineStack metadata spec compliance audit
body:
Systematic audit of all `examples/` defineStack configurations against `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`. Found missing required fields, non-snake_case field names, inconsistent object definition patterns, and missing view definitions.

### Dashboard fixes
- Added `type: 'dashboard'` to todo and kitchen-sink dashboards
- Added `description` to todo and CRM dashboards for consistency

### msw-todo refactor
- Replaced plain object `TaskObject` with `ObjectSchema.create` + `Field.*` builders to match other examples
- Renamed `isCompleted` → `is_completed`, `createdAt` → `created_at` (spec requires `/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/`)
- Removed redundant manual `id` field

```typescript
// Before
export const TaskObject = {
  name: 'task',
  fields: {
    id: { name: 'id', label: 'ID', type: 'text', required: true },
    isCompleted: { name: 'isCompleted', label: 'Completed', type: 'boolean' },
  }
};

// After
export const TaskObject = ObjectSchema.create({
  name: 'task',
  fields: {
    subject: Field.text({ label: 'Subject', required: true }),
    is_completed: Field.boolean({ label: 'Completed', defaultValue: false }),
  },
});
```

### Missing views
- Added explicit grid + kanban views for kitchen-sink objects
- Added grid view for msw-todo

### CRM action fixes
- Added missing `successMessage` on `opportunity_mark_lost` action
- Added missing `successMessage` on `account_merge` action

### Automated compliance tests
- 30 new tests validating all 4 example configs against `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`
- Covers all 7 audit dimensions from the issue: objects (name/label/fields), views (presence + structure), dashboards (name/label/description/widgets), pages (name/label/type/regions), apps/navigation (id/type/label recursive), manifest (id/version/type/name/description), and normalized object format

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*

> <issue_title>examples 目录所有 defineStack 应用定义中元数据规范性系统排查与清单</issue_title>
> <issue_description># 问题背景
> 
> 在对 dashboard 元数据进行 spec 协议合规性审查时，发现不仅 dashboard/widgets 有较多问题，**应用级的 defineStack（对象、views、apps、dashboards、pages 等）元数据整体规范性也存在疏漏**，包括但不限于以下症状：
> 
> - 某些对象未补全所有必须字段（如 `id`/`name`/`label`/`fields`/`type`）
> - view/list/page 部分元数据结构无效或拼写错漏
> - dashboard 级别的 design panel 各种 binding 字段遗漏
> - manifests/app/region 相关内容未对齐最新协议约束
> - example/todo、crm、kitchen-sink 三个主 demo 存在不一致或冗余字段
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 排查建议与维度
> 
> 1. **对象（objects）定义：** name/label/fields/type 必填，fields 需对齐协议支持类型和格式，缺漏补齐，拼写一致。
> 2. **视图（views）/listViews/pageViews:** name、label、type 必填，columns/data/provider 等需严格校验。避免出现未注册 view 类型。
> 3. **dashboards/widgets:** 强制补全 dashboard 及 widget （id/title/object/categoryField/valueField/aggregate/filter），如前 issue objectstack-ai/objectui#824。
> 4. **pages/regions/components:** type、name、label、regions/children 等严格检查，兼容多栏布局和新协议模板结构。
> 5. **apps/navigations:** 导航项 id/type/label/targetName 必须全量对齐，icon 只用协议内官方图标。
> 6. **manifest:** id/version/type/name/description/data、权限等补足，规范嵌套层级与协议保持同步。
> 7. **i18n:** label/description 必须支持多语言或配置主语言 fallback。
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 排查流程建议
> 
> 1. 批量脚本检查 `examples/` 目录下所有 defineStack/app 导出的元数据对象，逐类提取缺或冗余的字段。
> 2. 逐个补齐或删冗余，对照 spec 协议修正格式和类型。
> 3. 补充自动化测试，断言每一份元数据通过 spec zod 校验且能正确被 UI/渲染层接受。
> 4. 文档和注释中同步校准用词、字段和协议声明，防止历史遗留类型渗透。
> 
> ---
>
